concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 1 – Data acquisition & synthetic preparation – T005/T006
concerns.text: FR-001 requires the system to download and extract the *existing* implicit‑failure subset from PlanBench‑XL. The tasks instead create a synthetic subset by injecting errors into successful tasks (T006), which weakens the functional requirement and violates the intended data‑preparation assumption.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 1 – Data acquisition & synthetic preparation – T007
concerns.text: FR-002 and Constitution Principle VI mandate that the failure‑signature JSON index be derived strictly from the ground‑truth definitions in the original dataset. T007 builds the index from the *synthetically injected* error pattern, thereby violating deterministic signature indexing.

Constitution Principle VII requires exclusive use of a two‑proportion z‑test. T012 implements a conditional branch that falls back to Fisher’s Exact Test when total_tasks < 30, contradicting the constitution and weakening the statistical rigor requirement (FR‑006).

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 1 – Data acquisition & synthetic preparation – T006
concerns.text: Limiting the injected subset to a fixed N = 50 tasks (T006) may reduce the sample size below the power needed for a valid statistical comparison, effectively narrowing the experimental scope beyond what the spec assumes (implicit‑failure subset of sufficient size). This retroactive narrowing weakens FR‑001 and SC‑003.
